jobs.description:
Join Our Growing Team - Future Opportunities Await!

We are excited to share that our company is experiencing significant growth and expansion, and as a result, we're on the lookout for talented individuals to join our team.

We want to be upfront about our hiring process. At this moment, we are in the process of securing projects that align with our business goals and objectives. Our intention is to ensure that once we bring new team members on board, they will have a meaningful and impactful role to play from day one. While we might not be able to extend an offer immediately, we are highly interested in considering you for these future projects.

If you're open to the idea of potentially joining our team in the future, we encourage you to continue with our interview process. We value your time and effort and believe that getting to know you better will help us make an informed decision.

Once you have effectively concluded the entire recruitment procedure, we will retain your profile and reach out to you once a suitable opportunity emerges. Additional interviews will not be necessary at this stage, and we anticipate being able to extend an offer to you promptly.

What does the recruitment process look like?

  1. Recruiter Screen

In the first call, our recruiter will learn more about you and your story to check a potential fit for gravity9. This is also an opportunity to ask your questions about the role and company. This step might take around 60 mins.

2. Tech 1 Interview with our software consultants

In this meeting your potential future teammate will take a deeper dive into your experience and what you could bring to the team.

This step will take around 90 mins.

3. Tech 2 Interview with our tech leads

In this meeting your potential future teammate will take a deeper dive into your experience and what you could bring to the team.

This step will take around 90 mins.

4. Final Interview

You made it to the very last stage! Here we already strive to cooperate with you and give you an opportunity to meet our leadership team during this informal talk. This step will take around 30 mins.

We are looking for a smart, enthusiastic backend software engineer with experience in MongoDB and a keen interest in current technology and engineering. Using your knowledge of Java and MongoDB, and engineering best practices, you will be involved in helping clients to adopt the latest version of MongoDB across a suite of their application. You will take an active lead in team discussions and code reviews and work collaboratively with your colleagues to identify, prioritise and deliver features which bring value to our clients. You will also guide less experienced developers.

We believe small, multi-disciplinary teams are most effective in delivering complex change. As such, we are looking for someone with a collaborative mindset who is happy to be flexible and take on different responsibilities over the lifetime of our projects.

Requirements

Role requirements - technical skills and experience

This role will suit a highly capable developer with extended working experience with Java, AND/OR Python and MongoDB (or any other NoSQL database).

Must-Have:

  • Excellent command / highly proficient in spoken and written English (working directly with UK/US-based clients)

  • Expert in Java 8+ and ideally having Java 11/14/17 and OpenJDK experience

  • Commercial experience with AND/OR Python is required

  • This role requires a willingness to upskill in additional technologies, including AND/OR Python

  • Hands-on experience with MongoDB or other NoSQL DB, including data modeling in NoSQL databases

  • Thorough understanding of Spring, especially Spring Boot, Spring Framework, Spring Data

  • Experience working with Azure or AWS

  • Understanding of Synch and Async communication (REST-based, Queue and/or Topic based (depending on technology)

  • Proficiency in working with Microservice Architecture

  • Including containerization, high availability, and failover scenarios

  • Experience writing unit and integration tests.

  • Experience in working with Docker and containerized applications

  • Experience in Maven/Gradle and working with CI/CD pipelines

Nice-to-Have:

  • AI integration

  • AWS Professional Certifications

Role requirements – soft skills

Key attributes and behaviours to succeed in this role will be:

  • Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical requirements

  • Customer Focus – passion for understanding the problem we are trying to solve with software and to advocate solutions to your client.

  • Delivery focus - strong analysis and problem-solving skills. Ability to evaluate, design and implement effective solutions. Flexibility to adapt skills to a spectrum of client engagements, use cases and modes of change delivery.

  • Exemplary standards of personal integrity and respect for others – professional approach to all aspects of client engagement and collaborative team working, able to quickly build relationships based on trust and transparency. Strong presentation and written and verbal communication are essential given the client facing nature of the role.

  • Value driven - Creative thinking, with aptitude for innovation and strong desire to exceed client expectations.

  • Energy – positive attitude and determination to learn and succeed.

jobs.description:
At RMgX Technologies, We are looking for driven professionals with strong hands-on Java expertise who can independently handle modules, mentor juniors, and actively contribute to building scalable solutions. At this level, you are expected to balance coding, ownership, and teamwork, while ensuring timely and quality delivery.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, develop, and deploy high-quality Java applications.
  • Work on REST APIs, Spring Boot, Hibernate for business-critical solutions.
  • Translate business requirements into efficient, maintainable, and testable code.
  • Ensure performance, scalability, and security in application design.
  • Guide and mentor Associates (L1/L2) and interns in coding practices.
  • Contribute to system design discussions, code reviews, and architectural improvements.
  • Debug, troubleshoot, and optimize code for better performance.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams in Agile environment.
  • B.E/B.Tech/MCA in Computer Science, IT, or related fields.

WORK EXPERIENCE

  • 3–4 years of Java backend development experience.
  • Proven experience in designing and developing scalable APIs and services.
  • Hands-on experience with Spring Framework (Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Boot).
  • Exposure to front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery) for integrations.
  • Experience in code reviews, performance optimisation, and mentoring juniors.

SKILLS, ABILITIES & KNOWLEDGE

  • Strong experience with Core Java (Java 8 and above) and OOPS concepts.
  • Hands-on expertise in Spring Framework, Spring Boot, Hibernate, REST APIs.
  • Knowledge of multithreading, annotations, templates, and design patterns.
  • Proficiency in RDBMS concepts (MySQL/Oracle).
  • Exposure to HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, Ajax for front-end integration.
  • Experience with Maven, Git, JUnit, logging frameworks (Slf4j/Log4j).
  • Problem-solving mindset with ability to take ownership of modules.
  • Good communication and leadership skills with mentoring capabilities.
  • Familiarity with Spring AI is a desirable/added advantage.
  • Flexible working hours
  • Health Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
  • BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) Benefit
  • Laptop Buyback Scheme

RMgX Technologies is a Digital Product Engineering firm focused on AI-powered product development, digital transformation, and complex systems integration. We are seeking a Data Specialist to play a key role in a mission-critical project. The role demands deep expertise in databases, ETL processes, and data workflows, with a strong sense of ownership and structured way of working. You will play a critical role in ensuring reliable, accurate, and scalable data systems that power the products and systems developed by RMgX

jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

Company Overview


On any given day, every moment matters to someone, somewhere. And every moment, Motorola Solutions’ innovations, products and services play essential roles in people’s lives. We help firefighters see around buildings and police officers see around street corners. We keep utility workers connected and visible to each other with real-time voice and data communication across the smart grid. And we provide the situational awareness first responders need when a moment brings catastrophe. We help people be their best in their moments that matter.

Department Description

The Product Orderability & Global Documentation group is responsible for product, software and services implementations in CRM, ERP and Product Lifecycle Management Systems. The Global documentation team is responsible for all product related user manuals, internal and external training materials on various front end and backend systems. Group has a global presence in all regions (North America, Europe and Asia). It is responsible for working with cross functional teams (Go-to-Market, Learning Management, Sales, Product Management, IT, Services) for end-to-end definition and implementation of product offers and configurations in CRM/ERP systems from Quoting to Fulfillment products and to provide better user experiences to our end customers, partners, resellers and Salesforce including product documentation and training material.


Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Database Engineering: Design, develop, and optimize complex SQL and PL/SQL scripts to support large-scale database environments.

  • System Integration: Develop and maintain Core Java applications and RESTful APIs to facilitate seamless data exchange between systems.

  • Requirement Gathering: Lead cross-functional collaboration sessions with product managers and stakeholders to translate business needs into technical specifications.

  • Performance Tuning: Apply deep knowledge of Oracle DB backend concepts to optimize database performance, indexing, and partitioning.

  • Architectural Oversight: Ensure all solutions align with standard RDBMS principles, maintaining data integrity, security, and scalability.

  • Legacy Code Review: Ability to read, analyze, understand and update legacy database queries, Java code and enhance it.

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree (4-year) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering field.

  • Experience: 4+ years of professional experience in database development and backend engineering.

  • Technical Stack:

    • Databases: Expert-level SQL and PL/SQL; experience with large-scale Oracle DB environments.

    • Programming: Proficiency in Core Java and building/consuming REST APIs.

    • Concepts: Strong grasp of RDBMS fundamentals, and relational modeling.

  • Soft Skills: Exceptional communication skills with a proven track record of working across departments (Product, QA, and DevOps).

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Oracle-specific tools (e.g., SQL Developer, Data Pump, or AWR reports).

  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and version control (Git).

  • Familiarity with cloud-based database services (AWS RDS or OCI).

  • Strong practical knowledge on modern JDKs (e.g. Java 21) and experience with best software development practices, like clean-code, SOLID rules, etc.).


Basic Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree (4-year) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering field.

  • 4+ years of professional experience in database development and backend engineering.

  • Expert-level SQL and PL/SQL; experience with large-scale Oracle DB environments.

  • Proficiency in Core Java and building/consuming REST APIs.

  • Strong grasp of RDBMS fundamentals, and relational modeling.

  • Exceptional communication skills with a proven track record of working across departments (Product, QA, and DevOps).


Travel Requirements

None


Relocation Provided

None


Position Type

Experienced

Referral Payment Plan

No

EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.
